verses.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

verses.text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Before anything else, there was God. The earth had no shape. It was empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. But even there, Church, in the dark, the Spirit of God was moving.

verses.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The first thing God made was light. He saw that it was good, and he divided the light from the dark. He named the light Day and named the darkness Night. Evening came, then morning, and that was the first day.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Day two, God made the sky, the wide firmament, and divided the waters above from the waters below. Day three, he gathered the seas together, and dry land came up. Then the land turned green. Grass and plants with seed, and trees with fruit, each one after its kind. God looked, and it was good.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Day four, God hung lights in the sky. The sun to rule the day, the moon to rule the night, and the stars too. Day five, he filled the waters with living things and the air with birds of every kind. He blessed them and told them to be fruitful and multiply.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Day six, God made the animals of the land, the cattle and the creeping things and the wild beasts, each after its kind. And then he did something new.

verses.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Made in the image of God. Male and female. Hear me, Church. Every person you will ever meet carries that image. The one the world overlooks carries it. You carry it. God blessed them and gave them the care of the earth, and gave them the plants and the fruit for food.

verses.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: When I say all the time, you say, God is good. All the time. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "God is good"] God is good. [PAUSE 3s | screen: "All the time"] He looked at all he made and called it very good.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Notice the difference. After each day, God saw that it was good. But when he looked at all of it together, with people in it, he saw that it was very good.

verses.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: And on the seventh day, God rested. He blessed that day and set it apart. The story of creation does not end with more work. It ends with rest.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The world began with light coming into darkness and order coming to what was empty, and a God who called it good. At the end of a long day, that is a good story to lay down with. Light first. Then everything else. Then rest.

first_reader.note: Drafted and read by Claude in the landing session; no free-model draft (QA_NO_FREE_MODEL not needed).

pastor.note: Faithful to Genesis 1:1-2:3; no side taken on how the days are read.

cultural.note: 'You carry it' says the image of God plainly and with dignity, no race claim.
